summary: Kohl's Corporation filed an 8-K on August 18, 2026, announcing that its Board of Directors declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.125 per share on common stock. The dividend is payable September 23, 2026, to shareholders of record on September 9, 2026. A press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1. This is a routine quarterly dividend declaration, not a special-situation event such as a capital return program or tender offer. The filing contains no strategic action, merger, or activist involvement. There is no deal structure, premium, or special terms to analyze. The filing is purely informational and ordinary course.
